_readme: Concept renderings and layout ideas, not photos of completed work. Images live in images/concepts/. See UPDATING.md.

concepts.title: Ground Floor Plan Study
concepts.description: A measured layout: kitchen with meat and dairy sides — each with its own sink and range — a pareve island, a dining table for 14, entry and stair, powder room, living room, and a front porch.

concepts.title: Kitchen & Dining Layout Sketch
concepts.description: A tracing-paper sketch testing the island, counters and table placement.

concepts.title: Friday Night Dining Room
concepts.description: A brownstone dining room set for Shabbos: candlesticks, challah, and soft evening light.

concepts.title: Two-Zone Kosher Kitchen
concepts.description: Meat and dairy sides, each with its own sink and stove, and a marble island for pareve prep.

concepts.title: Seforim Library Living Room
concepts.description: Floor-to-ceiling walnut shelving with a library ladder and brass reading lights.

concepts.title: Yom Tov Dining for Twenty
concepts.description: An extended table, a glass-front china cabinet for holiday dishes, and twin chandeliers.

concepts.title: Brownstone Foyer
concepts.description: An arched entry with a mezuzah, a curved walnut stair, and a checkered marble floor.

concepts.title: Mudroom & Entry Storage
concepts.description: Built-in cubbies, hooks and a bench, with tall cabinets for coats and Pesach dishes.

concepts.title: Shared Kids' Room
concepts.description: Built-in sage bunks with brass rails, reading nooks, and lots of drawers.

concepts.title: Calm Primary Bedroom
concepts.description: Layered linen, a bouclé reading chair, and a sunny bay window.
